{{Top|leg}}
'''Aurenia''' was an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After producing non-functional replicas of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] of several [[Dark Council]] members, Aurenia went into hiding because of [[Death/Legends|death]] threats.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Of Art and Suffering}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The German description of the crew skill mission in the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' hints on Aurenia being a [[Gender|Female]].<ref name="TOR" />
